result.title: FMA-Net: Flexible Modality Adaptation for Robust Multimodal Face Presentation Attack Detection
result.summary: Multimodal face presentation attack detection (fPAD) improves robustness using complementary RGB, depth, and infrared (IR) cues, but deployment remains challenging when modalities are unavailable or incomplete. Existing flexible-modality methods mainly use zero-filling or modality omission, potentially discarding cross-modal information and introducing modality-dependent bias. We propose the Flexible Modality Adaptation Network (FMA-Net), a unified framework that compensates for missing modalities through instruction-guided latent-space translation. The Face Modality Instruct Translator (FMIT) estimates target modality observations from RGB inputs, while context-aware category enhancement uses learnable text prompts as modality-invariant semantic anchors. A Facial Feature Adapter (F2A) integrates global facial structure and local spoof-relevant cues to enhance discriminative representations. Synthetic-to-Real Face Domain Alignment (SR-FDA) reduces feature discrepancies between translated and real modalities, with benefits depending on the missing-modality pattern and data domain. Experiments on WMCA and PADISI-Face validate the framework. On WMCA with a 70% modality missing ratio, FMA-Net achieves a mean ACER of 3.22% across four intra-domain missing-modality protocols, compared with 4.24% for the strongest baseline by the same criterion. When both depth and IR are entirely unavailable, it achieves 5.23% ACER, compared with 5.99% for the best competing result. Cross-domain experiments also reveal limitations of synthetic-to-real alignment under dataset shifts. These results support FMA-Net as a practical approach to fPAD with flexible and incomplete modalities.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FMA-Net，用指令引导的 latent 空间翻译从 RGB 估计缺失的深度或红外模态，并以可学习文本提示作模态不变语义锚点、配合合成到真实特征的域对齐，用于模态不完整条件下的人脸展示攻击检测。
AI.relevance_reason: 「由可见模态经 latent 翻译补出缺失模态」可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据补全与模态不变锚点的做法，但任务属安全检测、与推理期状态生成距离较远，需确认翻译表示是否被下游真正使用而非仅作数据增广。
